reason: The submitted I4/mmm ThMn12-type model is sufficiently established. The tetragonal cell is decisively indexed (all 20 selected strong lines, M(20)=109.3), the full pattern has no material unexplained peaks, and independent profile refinements give a very good fit (custom Rwp about 3.56%; GSAS-II wR about 3.04%) with refined a, c, x(Ga-8i), and x(Co-8j) consistent with the CIF. The trajectory explicitly instantiated and compared all three multiplicity-8 Ga/Co site assignments: Ga on 8i was strongly preferred over Ga on 8f or 8j (RSS about 1340 versus 5001 and 6296 before later profile improvements), including diagnostic weak reflections. The resulting fully occupied Tb2Ga8Co16 cell is chemically plausible, has a sensible minimum contact of about 2.44 angstrom, and round-trips as I4/mmm with Z=2. Although the standardized comparable-Rwp report was unavailable, the direct whole-pattern and ordering tests adequately support the cell, framework, symmetry, coordinates, occupancies, and element ordering; no materially different scientifically motivated candidate remains likely to improve the set.
